rows.text: Portfolio Dashboard — Track Your $100K Virtual Trading Performance | TradeHQ
Track your virtual investments, analyze performance, and manage simulated risk.

Confirmed virtual trades update cash, holdings and trade history immediately. Guest records stay in this browser, and holding prices can refresh while TradeHQ is open. Signed-in accounts sync about every minute while TradeHQ is open and when relevant server updates arrive. The server checks supported account holdings' reference prices about every five minutes, even while you're offline. Provider data may be delayed, cached or unavailable; this is not a tick-by-tick live trading feed.
Account values are checked while TradeHQ is open and whenever supported server updates arrive.

Enter a hypothetical move for a rule-based simulation. Results are illustrative, not forecasts.
Assumptions: the requested shock is spread across the chosen horizon with fixed daily variability:

.
        Asset moves are independent; cross-asset correlation, costs and market events are not modeled.
        The 1,000 random paths produce illustrative sample means, percentiles and loss frequencies,
        not calibrated market probabilities. A frequency near 50% has about ±3 percentage points
        of simulation sampling uncertainty, before model uncertainty. The horizon is limited to 1–365 days.
        Requested losses below −99% are clamped to −99%. Target a held symbol, an asset class, or all holdings.
        Sector-specific targets are unavailable.
